name: DBLP_and_Imported_Publications
description: Certify that all publications of the author have been imported into OpenReview
title: Certify your DBLP status and that all publications are imported
instructions: Please fill out this form **truthfully**. It is crucial for the integrity of the review process. Providing false information may lead to rejection of your submission or other sanctions.

dblp_status.description: Is there a DBLP author URL for you, just a DBLP disambiguation page, or no DBLP URL at all? An example of a DBLP author URL is https://dblp.org/pid/m/AlistairMoffat.html, an example of a DBLP disambiguation page is https://dblp.org/pid/30/2395

enum: There is a DBLP author URL for me, I have entered it into my OpenReview profile, and at least 90% of the publications listed there are indeed mine
There is a DBLP author URL for me, I have entered it into my OpenReview profile, but less than 90% of the publications listed there are mine
There is only a DBLP disambiguation page for my name
There is no DBLP URL at all for my name

dblp_disambiguation_url.description: If there is a DBLP disambiguation page for your name, please provide the URL here (OpenReview does not allow entering disambiguation pages in the profile). If there is a DBLP author URL or no URL at all, please leave this field blank.

imported_publications.description: Please certify that you have imported **all** your publications into your OpenReview profile. The "Add DBLP Papers to Profile" and "Add ORCID Papers to Profile" buttons can be found in your OpenReview profile under Edit profile → Personal Links. The "OpenReview Archive Direct Upload" can be found at https://openreview.net/group?id=OpenReview.net/Archive#tab-publications.

enum: There is a DBLP author URL for me, I have entered it into my OpenReview profile, and I have imported all publications from that URL that are mine into my OpenReview profile using the "Add DBLP Papers to Profile" button

There is no DBLP author URL for me (only a disambiguation page or no DBLP presence at all), and I have imported all my publications into my OpenReview profile using the "Add ORCID Papers to Profile" button or the "OpenReview Archive Direct Upload"
There are no publications in my name yet
